images.title: The five cubes with three digits
images.purpose: Shows the cubes from 64 to 1000 in a row, with the five three digit cubes 125, 216, 343, 512 and 729 highlighted.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One horizontal row of seven cards across the middle, with one bracket above the middle five.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 7 rounded rectangle cards of equal size in one horizontal row. The first card reads 64 and the last reads 1000; both are outlined in grey (#6B7280) with grey text. The middle 5 cards read 125, 216, 343, 512 and 729 and are filled teal (#0072B2) with white text. A dark bracket above the 5 teal cards is tagged 3 digits. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Exactly five cubes, 5³ to 9³, have three digits.
images.description: Shows the cubes from 64 to 1000 in a row, with the five three digit cubes 125, 216, 343, 512 and 729 highlighted.
